description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno3_eno1_D1y_extrapolate_bc (added by PR #41). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the per-axis hybrid WENO3/ENO1 upwind y-derivative D(u, wrt: y) (priority 10) replaced by the rule's body (seven regions: hybrid interior block [3,6]x[3,6], the ENO1 strips, and the two guarded-extrapolation ghost wall lines y=1, y=8) carrying the free names dx, dy, wind_u, wind_v, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells, with zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in EVALUATION position (the model's equations) and zero surviving metaparameter names. Surviving apply_expression_template nodes in the equations are expected and are NOT a violation: since the Option B reference-preserving switch (ESS 0.9.0, EarthSciAST aff96f29) the loader does not inline match-less template bodies -- a reference denotes its expansion and the engine treats it as a leaf (esm-spec 9.6.4) -- so each surviving apply is a resolved match-less leaf (eno1_minmod, the WENO reconstruction, the ghost closure), not an un-fired rule. The spatial D nodes that survive live in the retained expression_templates registry, in the rule's own match PATTERN, which reaches neither evaluation nor compilation; the equations themselves carry none. Measured on this fixture, not assumed. The interior block is one cell wider on each side of y than the WENO5 sibling's, because the WENO3 stencil reaches two cells rather than three; that widening is the structural difference this case exists to pin. No golden is committed with this fixture: the case is marked "status": "pending-golden", which scripts/compare-outputs.py reports as SKIP for the golden gate while STILL running the runner-output gate (every binding must lower the rule without erroring) and the cross-binding-bytes gate (all five bindings must produce identical canonical bytes). The golden is installed by scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh, which flips this status to "active"; see the PR body for why it is deferred to the repo-wide regeneration rather than pinned here.
